configurations.description: One configuration for each round of the wave. The loop script sets minItems and maxItems to the wave size.

sparsity.description: Fraction of the weights in the pruned layers to remove.

steps.description: Number of pruning steps. 1 is one-shot pruning.

finetune_epochs.description: Total fine-tuning epochs, divided into one block for each step. Must be at least steps.

lr.description: Learning rate at the start of each fine-tuning block. It decays with a cosine curve in the block.

exclude_layers.description: Layers that the round job does not prune. These layers still count in the weights left.

hypothesis.description: The idea that this configuration tests, in one or two sentences.

predicted_val_accuracy.description: The validation accuracy that you expect.

pass_probability.description: The probability that the round keeps the accuracy threshold.

summary.description: How the configurations of this wave differ, and why.
